title: Capture OAuth client_id from app.wiz.io login
instruction: Open https://app.wiz.io/login in Chrome. Open DevTools → Network → filter by 'authorize'. Click 'Sign in with SSO' button (NOT the email form). Watch for redirect to https://auth.wiz.io/authorize?client_id=XXXXXXXX. Copy the client_id value.
unlocks: OAuth redirect_uri chain → Critical account takeover if win-test.wiz.io accepted

title: Claim win-test.wiz.io on Vercel (subdomain takeover PoC)
instruction: ONLY for PoC documentation — do NOT serve malicious content. On Vercel: add win-test.wiz.io as a custom domain (DNS proves ownership via the CNAME 37e7f43d8158e70f.vercel-dns-013.com). Serve a benign 'PoC by <researcher>' page. Screenshot. Remove immediately after.
commands: # 3. curl https://win-test.wiz.io/ to confirm PoC page loads
expected_output: Your PoC page loads at https://win-test.wiz.io/
